name: Aguas Andinas S.A.
summary: Aguas Andinas S.A., together with its subsidiaries, constructs and operates as a water utility company in Chile. It engages in the catchment of raw water; production, transportation, and distribution of water; and the collection, treatment, and disposal of sewage. The company provides integral advisory and management services in sewage and liquid waste; sells equipment and nonconventional renewable energies; develops energy projects relating to sanitation companies; and offers laboratory sampling and environmental analysis services.
